pages.title: Blood of Three Dragons
pages.text: Three dragon bloods lend this emblem power to improve human-form combat breath.

pages.title: Crafting the Emblem
pages.text: Place a name tag at the top center and dragon's breath in the center. Put fire, ice, and lightning dragon blood on the left, right, and bottom; their positions are interchangeable.

pages.title: Effects by Dragon Type
pages.text: Fire and ice dragons prepare the next burst sooner, while lightning dragons can breathe longer.$(br2)The same emblem helps each type in a different way.
